stem: What happens next in this passage after “Old seeds may contain traits useful for future farming.”?
options: The inn made history feel ordinary in a good way.
The class then tried growing plants under different conditions in the school lab.
The growing plants made the past alive in a literal way.
It said, "These plants are growing for your lunch next month."
